post.summary: Import many locations in one transaction
post.description: All or nothing. code is optional per row: left out, it is rackName + rackNumber (e.g. A + 01 = A01), and the joined value must be at most 20 characters. A code repeated within the file is a 400 keyed rows.<n>.code, as is any row that fails validation; then nothing is written. A code that already exists in the table is skipped and listed in skipped with reason duplicate_in_db, so the same file can be imported again. Needs location.create (otherwise 403). Validation failure is 400 with errors keyed like rows.4.code, where the row number starts at 1.

get.summary: Monthly price history of a supplier for one year
get.description: One row per item: the supplier's own items plus any item already priced there that year. harga holds January to December in rupiah excluding PPN, null where no price is set. rataRata is the mean of the set months, null when none. tahun defaults to the current year.

put.summary: Save supplier prices for one year
put.description: Saves the changed cells in one call. harga null clears that month. items.price is not changed. Returns the same grid as GET.

get.description: Newest tanggalPo first. search matches nomorPo and supplier name. status filters ISSUED or CANCELLED. startDate and endDate are inclusive.

post.description: nomorPo is generated (PO-001, PO-002, ...). The approval request must be a purchase-request (400 when it is another type) in status approved (409 when it is not). A missing request or supplier is a 404. One request may have several POs. subtotal, dppLain, nilaiPpn and grandTotal are computed by the server and rounded to a rupiah: subtotal = sum of (jumlah * hargaSatuan - diskon), dppLain (DPP nilai lain) = subtotal * 11 / 12, nilaiPpn = dppLain * persenPpn / 100, grandTotal = subtotal + nilaiPpn + jasa. diskon is rupiah per line. Sending dppLain is a 400. A request that has a supplier mapping, or has no PO yet, is ordered through the mapping: every barang line carries lineIndex, the supplier must have that line mapped, jumlah must equal the mapped qty, and an already ordered line is a 409; anything else is a 400. Only a request that already had a PO before mapping existed may skip lineIndex. Optional Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters): with it, the same key and payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with the same status and header Idempotency-Replayed: true and does not repeat the write; the same key with a different payload is 409; a malformed key is 400. Without it the request behaves as before.

get.summary: Get a purchase order with its lines

put.description: Needs purchase-order.update. Only while status is ISSUED, 409 once cancelled. No time limit. Sends tanggalPo, picSupplier, persenPpn, jasa and the full barang list, which replaces the old lines; totals are recomputed with the same rules as create. supplierId, approvalRequestId and nomorPo cannot change: sending them is a 400. 404 when the PO does not exist.

post.description: Needs purchase-order.cancel. reason is required (1 to 255 characters). Only from ISSUED, 409 when already cancelled; cancelling is final. No effect on stock. The purchase request stays approved, so a new PO can be made from it. Sets status, cancelledAt, cancelledBy and cancelReason.

get.summary: Export a purchase order as xlsx
get.description: Needs purchase-order.view. One sheet with the header, the lines and the totals. Money and dates are real Excel numbers and dates. Works for cancelled POs too, which show the status and reason.

200.description: xlsx file, sent as an attachment

get.summary: Count approved purchase requests by ordering progress
get.description: Needs purchase-order.view. notStarted: no mapping yet. partial: some mapping, not every line fully mapped. completeNoPo: every line fully mapped but some mapped row has no PO yet. poIssued: every line fully mapped and every row has a PO.

get.summary: Get the supplier mapping of a purchase request
get.description: Needs purchase-order.view. 400 when the request is not a purchase-request, 409 when it is not approved. Each line of the request lists the suppliers it is mapped to with qty and, once a PO was issued from the row, purchaseOrderId and nomorPo (null otherwise, also after that PO is cancelled). status is NOT_STARTED, PARTIAL, or COMPLETE when every line is fully mapped. Suppliers are never prefilled from the item master.

put.summary: Save the supplier mapping of a purchase request
put.description: Needs purchase-order.create. Only the lines sent are replaced; others stay as they are, so mapping can be done in steps. A line may go to several suppliers. The total qty of a line, rows already ordered included, must stay within the line qty; a supplier cannot appear twice on a line; rows already ordered are locked. 400 for an unknown lineIndex or a bad total, 404 for an unknown supplier, 409 when the request is not approved. Returns the same body as GET.

put.description: Changing price needs the item.set-price permission (Purchasing), otherwise 403. Changing supplierId, including null to clear it, needs item.set-supplier (Purchasing), otherwise 403; resending the unchanged supplierId is accepted. detail null clears the detail. Resending the unchanged price is accepted, and omitting price keeps the current one. category and unit must be names from GET /api/v1/items/categories and /units, 400 otherwise. The code cannot be sent. When category changes and the item was never used on a transaction line (inbound, inbound return, outbound, stock opname, material request, SPK internal, dokubah material), the item gets a new code from the new category's prefix and the old and new code are written to the audit log. A used item keeps its code, so the client sees the category changed and the code did not.

put.summary: Rename one of the item categories
put.description: Needs item.update. Items use the name through a foreign key with ON UPDATE CASCADE, so every item takes the new name. Old documents (purchase order lines, dokubah, penawaran) keep the name they were made with. Changing only the letter case of its own name is allowed. Categories may also send prefix to change it; existing item codes are not renamed. 404 when the id does not exist, 409 when another row has the name.

post.summary: Import many items in one transaction
post.description: Names, not ids: category, unit and locationCode are resolved case-insensitively, and a row falls back to defaults for category and unit. supplier is optional per row (no defaults.supplier): a name is matched case-insensitively to suppliers.name, a name that matches no supplier or more than one is a row error under items.<row>.supplier, and left out means supplierId null until Purchasing sets one with PUT /api/v1/items/{id}. It is the first mapping only. Nothing is auto-created. An unknown or ambiguous name, a missing value, or a missing permission fails the whole request. Needs item.create, plus item.set-price when any price is not 0, item.adjust-stock when any stock is above 0, item.assign-location when any row has locationCode, and item.set-supplier when any row has supplier (otherwise 403). Superadmin passes all of them. A row's code is the code the item came with and is stored as externalCode; the internal code is generated from the category prefix. A row already in the database (same code as an item's externalCode or code, or same name when the row has no code and the stored item has no externalCode) or repeated earlier in the file is skipped and listed in skipped, so the same file can be imported again. Initial stock is recorded as an audit entry with reason 'Initial import'. With dryRun true nothing is written and items[].id is null. Validation failure is 400 with errors keyed like items.4.category, where the row number starts at 1.

get.summary: Stock card: every stock movement of one item
get.description: Needs item.view. entries are oldest first (date, then createdAt): inbound receipts (MASUK, whatever the QC status, qtyArrived is added), outbound lines (KELUAR) and stock opname differences (PENYESUAIAN, zero differences skipped). Inbound returns and SPK internal do not change stock and are not listed. openingBalance + sum(qtyIn) - sum(qtyOut) = item.stock. Optional startDate/endDate (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) narrow the entries; openingBalance is then the balance before startDate and endDate only trims the entries; manual stock adjustments and the initial import fall into openingBalance. 404 when the item does not exist.

post.description: Needs item.upload-photo. Accepts one image in the photo field (JPEG, PNG or WebP, 10 MB max). The server makes two WebP files under /uploads/items: a thumb at most 400px and a display at most 2000px, with EXIF rotation applied. The previous photo files are deleted. 400 for a wrong type, an oversized or missing or unreadable file, 404 when the item does not exist. The URLs are returned in photo.thumb and photo.display.

post.summary: Upload photos for up to 10 items in one request
post.description: Needs item.upload-photo. Each file is a form field named photo_<itemId> (for example photo_12), at most 10 files, 10 MB each, one per item. Files are processed one by one with the same rules as POST /items/{id}/photo. A bad file does not fail the request: it is listed in failed with a reason (not_found, invalid_type, too_large, unprocessable) and the others still save. 400 when there are no files, a field name is not photo_<itemId>, an itemId is sent twice, there are more than 10 files, or a file is over 10 MB.

post.summary: Record goods received from a supplier or production
post.description: Raises the item's stock by qtyArrived in the same transaction and records audit logs. statusQc is the result of the manual QC check, not derived from the quantities. When source is SUPPLIER (the default) and supplierId is left out, it is taken from the item's mapped supplier; 400 when the item has none. qtyPurchased is optional. Optional Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters): with it, the same key and payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with the same status and header Idempotency-Replayed: true and does not repeat the write; the same key with a different payload is 409; a malformed key is 400. Without it the request behaves as before.

locationCode.description: Where the item is stored now
Where the item is stored now

post.summary: Record several received items in one request
post.description: Needs inbound.create and an Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters, one per draft). All lines or none: one database transaction, stock raised under a row lock per item. lines holds 1 to 200 entries, qtyArrived is at most 100000 per line. supplierId comes from items.supplierId for source SUPPLIER; a line whose item has no supplier, or an unknown itemId, fails the whole request with 400 and errors keyed lines.<index>.itemId (index from 0), and nothing is written. Same key and same payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with the same status and header Idempotency-Replayed: true, without adding stock again. Same key with a different payload is 409. A missing or malformed key is 400. A failed request stores no key, so it can be corrected and sent again with the same key.

201.description: Every line recorded, or the stored answer of an earlier identical request

locationCode.description: Where the item is stored now

409.description: Idempotency-Key already used with a different payload

post.summary: Record a scanner session: goods that passed QC and goods returned to the supplier
post.description: Needs inbound.create and an Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters), with the same replay rules as POST /inbound/batch: same key and payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed: true and adds nothing, same key with a different payload is 409. pass lines are SUPPLIER receipts with statusQc PASS and raise stock. retur lines are only recorded as a return to the item's supplier, one return request per supplier, and never change stock. Both take supplierId from items.supplierId. pass and retur each hold 0 to 200 lines, at least one line in total, qty at most 100000 per line, reason 1 to 255 characters. All or nothing: a bad line fails the whole request with 400 and errors keyed pass.<index>.<field> or retur.<index>.<field>, index from 0, for example retur.2.itemId for an unknown item or an item without a supplier.

Stock moves by the net difference per item in one transaction, 400 if any item would drop below 0. 409 once more than 24 hours have passed since the transaction was recorded.

get.summary: List SPK numbers with their client
get.description: Source of the SPK and its client for dokubah, SPK internal, outbound, material requests and client returns, and for the dropdowns of Barang Keluar. Dummy data plus a fixture built from the tracking database until the tracking system API is connected, the shape stays the same. search matches noSpk or client, case-insensitively. client keeps only the SPK of that client name (exact, case-insensitive, trimmed), and can be combined with search. limit defaults to 50 and is capped at 100, applied after client. projectName is included when the tracking source sends it. Products are not listed here, use GET /api/v1/tracking/spk/{noSpk}.

Client names taken from the SPK list, unique and sorted A to Z. Needs dokubah.view. search matches the client name only, case-insensitively. limit defaults to 50 and is capped at 100. Pick one name here, then list its SPK with GET /api/v1/tracking/spk?client=.

get.summary: Get one SPK with its client and products
get.description: Needs dokubah.view. noSpk is matched exactly. Numbers can contain slashes, so send them URL-encoded (encodeURIComponent). products are what tracking knows for that SPK, merged when tracking holds the same number more than once, and may be empty: then Barang Keluar only offers Stok. outbound itemName is not validated against products. 404 when the SPK is unknown.

get.summary: Stock mutations, inbound and outbound together
get.description: Inbound transactions are Masuk, each outbound line is Keluar. Newest first. tanggal is the transaction date (YYYY-MM-DD), transactions carry no time. noReferensiSpk is the SPK, or the reference number for an inbound without one. lokasi filters on the item's location code. id is a string, in-<id> or out-<lineId>.

get.summary: Stock opname totals for a period
get.description: totalAudit is the number of opnames, totalItemSelisih the counted lines whose physical quantity differs from the system quantity, totalAdjustmentNilai the rupiah value of those differences at the line price (negative is a loss). Both filters are optional.
One row per document line, each carrying its document header. Newest tanggalTerbit first. search matches noSpk, spkKlienInduk, sku or namaBarang.

sku.description: Item code, empty when the item has none

totalBuffer.description: Sum of totalQty of BUFFER lines

dialokasikan.description: Sum of totalQty of LOCKED lines

summary.description: Over every line the filters match, not just the page

post.summary: Create an SPK internal document with its lines
post.description: noSpk is generated. spkKlienInduk must be one of GET /api/v1/tracking/spk and penanggungJawab one of GET /api/v1/tracking/pic, 400 otherwise. Per line alokasiSpkKlien + alokasiStokBebas must equal totalQty, and totalBisaPakai starts at alokasiStokBebas. An item may appear once per document.

sku.description: Item code, empty when the item has none

get.description: id is the line id from the list. Same row shape as the list. 404 when unknown.

sku.description: Item code, empty when the item has none

post.description: id is the line id from the list. Subtracts jumlah from totalBisaPakai. 400 when jumlah is not a positive integer or is more than totalBisaPakai. The line becomes LOCKED at 0. Item stock is not changed. Optional Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters): with it, the same key and payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with the same status and header Idempotency-Replayed: true and does not repeat the write; the same key with a different payload is 409; a malformed key is 400. Without it the request behaves as before.

sku.description: Item code, empty when the item has none

get.description: Newest period first. search matches the notes or the code/name of any counted item. Rows carry lineCount, lines are on the detail endpoint.

post.description: Sets each counted item's stock to physicalQty in one transaction and records audit logs. The price is not sent: systemPrice and physicalPrice on each line are both the item master price at that moment, and the master is never changed by an opname. An item may appear only once per opname. Optional Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters): with it, the same key and payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with the same status and header Idempotency-Replayed: true and does not repeat the write; the same key with a different payload is 409; a malformed key is 400. Without it the request behaves as before.

get.summary: Get one stock opname with its lines
get.description: Each line carries systemQty and systemPrice as they were when the count was recorded.

Requests for materials to be issued from the warehouse, not purchase requests. startDate and endDate are inclusive and filter on requestDate. search matches SPK, client, production item and tool group.

post.description: spk must be one of GET /api/v1/tracking/spk (400 otherwise) and clientName is taken from there, a clientName in the body is ignored. Always created as PENDING, with at least one item line. Creating a request or changing its status never changes stock, only outbound does. Optional Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters): with it, the same key and payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with the same status and header Idempotency-Replayed: true and does not repeat the write; the same key with a different payload is 409; a malformed key is 400. Without it the request behaves as before.

get.description: Needs checklist-dokubah.view. Same paging, search, filters and sorting as GET /api/v1/dokubah. hasChecklist tells whether Gudang saved a checklist for that dokubah.

namaItem.description: Project name from tracking, empty when unknown

get.summary: Get the checklist of a dokubah
get.description: Needs checklist-dokubah.view. checklist is null until the first save. 404 when the dokubah does not exist. Selisih is typed by the user and stored as typed (max 50, nullable).

namaItem.description: Project name from tracking, empty when unknown

put.summary: Save the checklist of a dokubah
put.description: Needs checklist-dokubah.edit. Creates or replaces the whole checklist, lines included, in one transaction and answers like GET. Every line must have exactly kolomRealisasi realisasi entries, jumlah >= 0, dates YYYY-MM-DD, tglSelesai on or after tglMulai. Fully empty lines are dropped. 404 when the dokubah does not exist.
